sql:
SELECT 
  cls,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(boat, '-', fish_date_doy)) as trip_count,
  ROUND(AVG(yt / (anglers + 1)), 3) as avg_yt_per_angler,
  ROUND(MIN(fish_date_doy), 0) as min_doy,
  ROUND(MAX(fish_date_doy), 0) as max_doy
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 6 AND yt IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY cls
ORDER BY avg_yt_per_angler DESC
LIMIT 20
